def cancel_or_delete_doc(
    action,
    doctype,
    name,
    force = False,
    ignore_permissions = False,
    ignore_on_trash = False,
    ignore_missing = False,
    ):
    # frappe.throw("Delete")
    if action in ("delete", "Delete"):
        frappe.delete_doc(
            doctype,
            name,
            force,
            ignore_permissions,
            for_reload,
            ignore_on_trash,
            ignore_missing
        )
    elif action in ("cancel", "Cancel"):
        doc = frappe.get_doc(doctype, name)
        doc.cancel()

name: get_item_quantity_factor
script:
def get_factor(item):
    item_doc = frappe.get_doc("Item", item)
    if item_doc.is_stock_item:
        return 1
    sql = """
        SELECT SUM(qty) as factor
        FROM `tabProduct Bundle Item` pbi
        JOIN `tabProduct Bundle` pb on pb.name = pbi.parent
        WHERE pb.new_item_code = %(item)s
        AND pb.disabled = 0
    """
    result = frappe.db.sql(sql, {"item": item}, as_dict=True)[0]
    return result.factor or 1
    
frappe.response.message = get_factor(args.get("item_code"))
